name: LGB + Range Ratio & Mean Diff (28 features)
description: LightGBM with 2 new Fneu-based features: range_ratio_f_fneu (Q95-Q5 ratio F/Fneu) and mean_diff_f_fneu (mean F - mean Fneu, normalized). 28 features total.
training_data: All labelled sessions in the preprocessed cache at the time (Stav + Inbar), excluding Yael, Stav3/21 and Stav22 (held out)
idea: New features: production set plus 2 neuropil features (F/Fneu range ratio, normalized mean F minus Fneu), 28 total.
